summary: Represents one or more physics bodies for Bullet or Nvidia Flex simulations, with SOP-defined collision shapes, static or dynamic kinematic state, forces, gravity, and solver feedback controls.

key_params.name: initialize
key_params.note: Recreate collision shapes, reset velocities, and reset position

key_params.name: updatecs
key_params.note: Automatically update collision shapes when source SOPs or shape settings change

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Include or remove the actor from the simulation

key_params.name: kinstate
key_params.note: Static infinite-mass or dynamic finite-mass body state

key_params.name: sops
key_params.note: Collision SOPs or COMP containing SOPs; blank uses displayed/rendered internal SOPs

key_params.name: shape
key_params.note: Concave, convex hull, bounding box, ellipsoid, sphere, or compound collision shape

key_params.name: forces
key_params.note: Local Force COMPs applied only to this actor

key_params.name: globalgrav
key_params.note: Use Bullet Solver COMP global gravity instead of local gravity

key_params.name: gravity
key_params.note: Local gravitational acceleration when not using global gravity

key_params.name: friction
key_params.note: Kinetic friction; effective friction is product of touching bodies

key_params.name: ccd
key_params.note: Continuous collision detection for fast-moving bodies

key_params.name: bulletfb
key_params.note: Feedback CHOP that can override transform and velocity at the next frame

key_concepts: Actor COMP represents one or more physics bodies that must be simulated by a Bullet Solver COMP or NVIDIA Flex Solver COMP.
Static actors have infinite mass, while dynamic actors move under forces and collide with other bodies in the simulation.
Collision bodies are built from Collision SOPs or internal display/render SOPs, and the visible geometry can differ from the collision shape.
Dynamic Bullet actors require convex or compound collision shapes; concave dynamic behavior must be built from multiple convex SOP pieces.
Initialize Actor is required after SOP, instancing, scale, or collision-shape changes so the solver sees the updated body definition.
common_gotchas: Actor COMP requires a physics solver such as Bullet Solver COMP or Nvidia Flex Solver COMP to simulate.
Dynamic Bullet bodies must use convex or compound collision shapes; concave dynamic shapes need decomposition into convex SOP parts.
The rendered geometry and collision shape can differ, so enable Display Guide when debugging collisions.
Pulse Initialize Actor after changing SOPs, instancing, or scale-dependent collision settings.
Actor COMPs cannot be nested inside Actor COMPs, and Geometry COMP scale around nested Actor COMPs requires careful reinitialization.
Continuous collision detection helps fast linear motion but has performance cost and does not solve every high angular velocity case.
build_relevance: 2020.20000+ Bullet/Flex physics actors and collision setup
